selected_priority: Automate attributable company-intelligence refresh with semantic change detection, historical provenance retention, partial-refresh preservation, and stale-signal retirement.
displaced_capability: Company intelligence could be loaded and freshness-filtered, but there was no executable refresh lifecycle. Updating a manifest risked silently overwriting changed observations, dropping still-fresh signals during partial refreshes, or losing stale provenance instead of retaining it for later reasoning.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: Reuse CompanyIntelligence and CompanySignal validation, preserving the existing company-fit and application-strategy contracts while adding lifecycle behavior around them.

Replace the manifest model with an external database or network crawler. This would expand infrastructure before solving the immediate lifecycle gap and would duplicate already-useful validation semantics.

Keep the validated manifest as active state, identify stable kind/source channels, compare semantic fingerprints, preserve omitted fresh observations, retire stale or superseded observations into append-only history, and expose the composition as an installed CLI with deterministic receipts.

capabilities: validates company identity and prevents collected_at time regression before refresh
detects semantic changes within stable company-signal kind/source channels
retires superseded observations with a replacement fingerprint instead of destroying prior provenance
retains still-fresh current observations omitted from partial incoming refreshes
retires absent stale observations into append-only history
rejects duplicate signal channels rather than silently last-write-wins collapsing them
prevents stale incoming observations from displacing fresher current evidence
writes active state and refresh receipt through atomic file replacement
appends retired observations to JSONL history
emits a SHA-256-bound machine-readable refresh receipt
preserves existing company-fit and company-aware application strategy interfaces

preserved_gains: existing CompanyIntelligence and CompanySignal validation remain the active data model
existing company-fit freshness filtering and recruiter strategy behavior remain unchanged
existing application lifecycle, queue, batch packet, and manual submission boundaries remain unchanged
candidate evidence remains separate from company-source provenance
no database migration or external submission side effect was introduced
